gen-gf-baumans-gf-didact-gothic: Wide-open crescent curves, all drawn with one uniform, unwavering line. Didact Gothic follows with a modern, contemporary read, its bowls never closing up enough to snag the eye.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-dotgothic16: A wide-opened crescent c and a stroke that never changes thickness mark Baumans out at once. Where Baumans is best at commanding attention, DotGothic16 is best at guiding the eye through its wide channels and tube-like bends.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-encode-sans-sc: Encode Sans SC reads with shallow terminal curls and wide gaps, so the eye moves forward without catching. Baumans commands attention like one thread, while Encode Sans SC carries the text.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-fustat: Baumans arrives with crescent-wrench curves and a commanding, tubelike stroke. Fustat then carries the text on lines like bent rope, with a wide gap where each c ends, so paragraphs move along without friction.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-google-sans: Baumans is all crescent-shaped curves in a single thickness. Beside it, Google Sans pulls its terminals well back and skips any swelling between downstrokes and curves, and that restraint is what holds the pairing together.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-google-sans-flex: Crescent-wide curves, drawn in one tubelike thickness. Baumans supplies the command and Google Sans Flex supplies the ribbon-cut stroke ends, and that division of labor is what makes both fonts work.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-gothic-a1: Baumans draws a tube-like, constant-width stroke, and every crescent curve of it feels deliberate and striking. The headline commands attention, while Gothic A1 and its splayed c terminal welcome.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-gowun-dodum: A crescent-shaped c, opened wide, sets Baumans apart. Gowun Dodum settles in beneath it with a wide-mouthed a and smooth, tube-like lines that let paragraphs flow without a snag.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-imprima: Commanding from the first letter, Baumans draws every stroke at a single thickness, tubelike and unwavering. And Imprima reads smoothly beneath it, its terminals flaring outward in a friendly way that keeps the text moving.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-jost: Generous crescent curves, one stroke width, zero fuss, all in Baumans. Jost follows with broad terminal gaps and a unit-width line of its own, so the two share a steady rhythm down the page.
